description: Get the hotels an AI platform actually recommends for a destination in a given week, ranked by how often it mentions them, with the split of links it gives each one (direct to the hotel, to an OTA, to a chain site, or elsewhere). Use this when the user asks which hotels ChatGPT or Gemini or Perplexity recommends in a city, whether a specific hotel or brand shows up in AI answers, who is winning AI visibility in a market, or how a destination's results differ between platforms. Get platform ids and city slugs from get_ai_hotel_landscape_manifest first.

city.description: City slug or name, e.g. "paris". Omit for all destinations.

client.description: Optional: identify yourself, e.g. "my-agent/1.0". Not required and never used by the tool itself — recorded only so the public tracker at /projects/agent-tools can measure how many callers self-identify when nothing forces them to.

platform.description: Platform id from the manifest, e.g. "chatgpt". Omit for all platforms.

week.description: Snapshot week as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the most recent.

name: get_ai_hotel_visibility
